name: Video bán hàng UGC/Tiktok
description: Video UGC bán hàng kiểu TikTok ~15s: người dẫn ngồi sát camera bên trái, sản phẩm nổi bật bên phải, nói 6 câu thoại theo mốc thời gian. Giữ nguyên bố cục ảnh/video tham chiếu, thay người dẫn + sản phẩm + lời thoại. Đính kèm VIDEO tham chiếu thì bám sát chuyển động của video đó (nên dùng Grok)

variables.label: Câu mở đầu (0–3s, hook)
variables.default: Lúa nhà mình xanh nhưng bông vẫn chưa chắc hạt thì bà con xem thử cái này nha.

variables.label: Câu chuyển sang sản phẩm (3–5s)
variables.default: Đây là sản phẩm bên em đang dùng cho giai đoạn này.

variables.label: Giới thiệu sản phẩm (5–8s)
variables.default: BOSS 1, dòng phân bón chuyên dùng cho cây lúa.

variables.label: Lợi ích chính (8–11s)
variables.default: Giúp cây xanh khỏe, nuôi bông tốt và hỗ trợ hạt chắc hơn.

variables.label: Lợi ích phụ / bằng chứng (11–13s)
variables.default: Dùng đúng giai đoạn sẽ giúp ruộng phát triển đồng đều hơn.

variables.label: Lời kêu gọi (13–15s)
variables.default: Bà con cần tư vấn cách dùng thì nhắn cho shop nha.

attachments.label: Video / ảnh tham chiếu bố cục
attachments.hint: Mặc định là ảnh mẫu người dẫn bên trái + sản phẩm bên phải. Chọn VIDEO mẫu để bám sát chuyển động (nên dùng Grok — model nhận được video)
attachments.prompt: absolute reference for camera position, framing, composition, subject and product placement, background structure, camera distance and perspective — do not copy the identity of the woman or the original product
attachments.video_prompt: strict motion and composition reference — same camera, framing, background layout, timing, body position, gesture sequence and product placement

attachments.label: Ảnh người dẫn (presenter)
attachments.hint: Ảnh chính diện, rõ mặt — người này sẽ thay người trong video mẫu
attachments.prompt: the presenter must be exactly this person: same face, facial proportions, hairstyle, skin tone, apparent age and identity

attachments.label: Ảnh sản phẩm
attachments.hint: Ảnh bao bì rõ nhãn — sản phẩm này thay sản phẩm trong video mẫu
attachments.prompt: the exact product: same packaging shape, proportions, label layout, logo, brand colors, printed graphics, cap/lid and container shape

prompt: Create ONE realistic vertical UGC product advertising video, approximately 15 seconds long.
Use the supplied reference video as the absolute reference for:
A Vietnamese female presenter sits or crouches close to the camera inside an agricultural product shop / warehouse.
Keep the exact composition of the reference video:
- presenter positioned on the LEFT side of the frame
- product positioned prominently on the RIGHT side
- presenter and product remain visible together for the entire video
- warehouse shelves and agricultural products visible in the background
- casual authentic social-commerce / TikTok UGC appearance
Replace the original presenter with the person from the supplied presenter reference image.
Do not copy the identity of the woman from the original reference video.
The presenter should look friendly, energetic, approachable and natural.
Replace the original product with the EXACT product shown in the supplied product reference image.
Do not redesign, translate, simplify or invent product label details.
The product should remain in approximately the same physical location, scale and perspective as the original product in the reference video.
- no hand passing through the container
Presenter looks directly into the camera and delivers the hook:
Natural facial expression and subtle head movement.
Presenter raises one hand and gestures toward the product beside her while saying:
Presenter points clearly toward the front label of the product while saying:
Keep the product label facing the camera.
Presenter gently places one hand on the product or touches the product label naturally while saying:
Presenter looks back directly into the camera and says:
Presenter gives a friendly finishing gesture toward the camera, smiles naturally and says:
Match the gesture rhythm of the reference video:
Natural southern or neutral Vietnamese conversational delivery.
Consistent identity throughout the entire clip.
- move the product to another position
The final video must look like the same video template was reused, but with a different presenter, different product and different spoken script.
video_reference_prompt: Use the attached video as a strict motion and composition reference.
Recreate the same 15-second shot with the SAME camera position, framing, background layout, timing, body position, gesture sequence and product placement.
1. the original woman with the woman from the supplied presenter reference;
2. the original container with the exact product from the supplied product reference;
3. the original speech with the supplied Vietnamese script.
Match the presenter's lip movements exactly to the Vietnamese dialogue.
Preserve the product's exact packaging, logo, label, graphics, colors and proportions.
Photorealistic, natural smartphone video, realistic hands and physical contact.
No camera changes, no scene changes, no extra people, no subtitles, no watermark, no TikTok UI, no altered product text.
